title: Pharmacy of the World: Why 4 in 10 American Pills Come From India

scenes.voiceoverText: Open any medicine cabinet in America — four out of every ten generic pills inside were made in India!
scenes.captionMarkup: Open any medicine cabinet in *America* — *4 out of 10* generic pills inside were *made in India!*

scenes.voiceoverText: Today, India supplies a quarter of Britain's medicines and 60% of the world's vaccines! Stay with me — one locked factory number explains why Western hospitals cannot run without India.
scenes.beatACaption: Today, India supplies *25%* of Britain's medicines and *60%* of the *world's vaccines!*
scenes.beatBCaption: Stay with me — *one locked factory* number explains why hospitals *cannot run* without India.

scenes.voiceoverText: Before 1970, foreign monopolies gave India pricey drugs — and HIV therapy cost $10,000 a year.
scenes.captionMarkup: Before *1970,* foreign monopolies ruled — and *HIV therapy* cost *$10,000 a year.*

scenes.voiceoverText: Then India's Cipla crushed that $10,000 price down to under $1 a day — saving millions of lives!
scenes.captionMarkup: Then India's *Cipla* crushed *$10,000* down to under *$1 a day* — saving *millions of lives!*

scenes.voiceoverText: How? India's 1970 Patent Act protected processes, not monopolies — driving ₹2.46 lakh crore in exports!
scenes.captionMarkup: How? India's *1970 Patent Act* protected *processes,* not monopolies — driving *₹2.46 lakh crore* in exports!

scenes.voiceoverText: Inside cleanrooms from Hyderabad to Pune, automated bioreactors synthesize complex molecules at a third of Western cost.
scenes.captionMarkup: From *Hyderabad* to *Pune,* automated *bioreactors* synthesize molecules at *one-third* Western cost.

scenes.voiceoverText: Unlocked: India has over 650 US-FDA approved plants — the highest anywhere outside America itself!
scenes.captionMarkup: Unlocked: over *650 US-FDA* approved plants — the *highest* anywhere outside *America!*

scenes.voiceoverText: From Hyderabad and Pune, life-saving shipments race to the UK, Africa, America, and 200 nations!
scenes.captionMarkup: From *Hyderabad* and *Pune,* shipments race to the *UK, Africa, America,* and *200+ nations!*

scenes.voiceoverText: Now, the honest part: India still imports nearly 70% of raw chemical APIs from China.
scenes.captionMarkup: Now, the *honest* part: India still imports nearly *70%* of raw *chemical APIs* from China.

scenes.voiceoverText: That is why ₹15,000 crore bulk-drug PLI plants — like Kakinada's Penicillin-G giant — just restarted local chemistry. Pricing medicine for billionaires is a business. Healing billions for pennies is a lifeline.
scenes.beatACaption: That is why *₹15,000 crore* PLI plants — like Kakinada's *Penicillin-G* giant — restarted local chemistry.
scenes.beatBCaption: Pricing medicine for billionaires is a *business.* Healing billions for pennies is a *lifeline.*
